title: Refine a restricted stage image over an image object
statement: Let $J$ be small filtered and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j,Q$ be precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with all transition and cocone functors continuous for the generated topologies. Suppose $V$ is a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i,G$ and maps $\alpha_t:F(t.hom)_sG\to V_{t.right}^s(V_{i,s}G)$ whose composites with the stage units equal the limit unit at every $X\in F(i)$, as objects of the arrow category. Fix $U\in F(i)$ and $x\in (V_{i,s}G)(V_iU)$. If $x\in S(V_iU)$ for the subpresheaf $S$ [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-stage-image], then there exist $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $z\in(F(t.hom)_sG)(F(t.hom)U)$ such that $\alpha_t(z)$ is heterogeneously equal to $x$. No finite-cover assumptions or sheaf condition for $S$ are required.

proof.text: Unpack membership into t, W, a presenting arrow f : V_i U to V_t W and a stage section z. Represent f using the arrow colimit, move to a common stage above i and t, then use eventual object equality to align its endpoints with the images of U and W. This produces a stage arrow whose image is f.

proof.text: Transpose the later unit to transport z to that stage, and restrict it along the lifted arrow. The two maps to the limit restriction sheaf have identical transposes, by hα and V.w; injectivity of the adjunction hom equivalence identifies them. Naturality at the lifted arrow proves that the new section has image x. Endpoint equalities give the stated HEq.

theorem colimit_site_stage_image_refinement
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (x : ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hx : x ∈ (colimitSiteStageImage F P V Q i G α).obj
      (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))) :
    ∃ (t : Under i)
      (z : ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))),
      HEq ((α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) z) x
